title: Geopolitical
description: To power your Nations and the Core of Poli-Nation!
body:
Essentially, this is a geopolitics mod. It is loosely based on the Towny plugin, but with other features and tailored for the SoDogCraft Modpack Poli-Nation.




That said, this mod still offers some great features, such as:

- Live war mechanics 
- Claim management
- All kinds of geopolitical actions
such as alliances, non-aggression pacts, and more...
- As well as a comprehensive GUI where you can:
* Create your own roles
* View your country’s status
* Manage members

Additionally, members can also instigate uprisings under the right conditions!


Furthermore, this mod offers a vast array of features, is well-designed, and will continue to receive new updates.
One feature that may be added in the future involves what happens to players who are, for example,
surrounded in a claim during a war—essentially, more realistic warfare.



This mod truly brings the SoDogCraft community project to life with interactive game mechanics such as alliances, nation-building, and politics.
Feel free to use this mod in your modpack if it suits your needs.
